query: INSERT INTO central.tool_calls (id, workspace_id, step_id, step_attempt_id, task_id, run_id, version, logical_operation_id, sequence, state, created_at, updated_at) SELECT $1, $2, a.step_id, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM central.step_attempts a WHERE a.workspace_id = $2 AND a.id = $3 ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
